lines.zh: 沙子从我八条腿间漏下去。
lines.en: Sand slips between my eight tiny legs.

lines.zh: 我横着挪过温热的浅滩。
lines.en: I sidle across the warm shallow flat.

lines.zh: 两只小钳子举得比头顶高。
lines.en: Both little claws are held above my head.

lines.zh: 丛林河底的碎石硌着我的脚。
lines.en: Pebbles in the jungle stream poke my feet.

lines.zh: 我沿着水边一步一步蹭。
lines.en: I creep along the waterline, step by step.

lines.zh: 沙面留下细细一串爪印。
lines.en: A thin trail of claw marks stays in the sand.

lines.zh: 我钻进沙里，只露出双眼。
lines.en: I sink into sand with only my eyes out.
The tide rises, so I back up the bank.

lines.zh: 两只蟹钳碰在一起咔一声。
lines.en: My two claws click together once.

lines.zh: 我绕过树根，继续横着走。
lines.en: I sidestep around the mangrove roots.
The water reaches only half my shell.

lines.zh: 我在河湾沙地上慢慢打转。
lines.en: I circle slowly on the river bend sand.
My steps are almost too light to hear.
I pause, then scuttle sideways again.
I sidle past the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 一缕水草挂在我的钳上。
lines.en: A strand of weed trails from my claw.

lines.zh: 我退半步，再往前挪一段。
lines.en: I back off half a step, then edge forward.

lines.zh: 河底的软泥被我踩出小坑。
lines.en: My feet pock the soft river bottom.

lines.zh: 我把钳子泡在水里凉着。
lines.en: I soak my claws in the water to cool them.

lines.zh: 沙粒卡在壳缝里，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Sand is stuck in my shell, so I shake it.

lines.zh: 我盯着一只漂过的水虫。
lines.en: I stare at a water bug drifting past.
The gills under my shell open and close.
I bury myself, leaving only eye stalks out.

lines.zh: 河面晃着光，我看得发呆。
lines.en: Light wavers on the river and I go still.

lines.zh: 我慢慢磨着一只空螺壳。
lines.en: I slowly grind an empty snail shell.
Holding my claws up makes them ache.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西落水。
lines.en: I hear something splash far away.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，眼睛转来转去。
lines.en: I stand sideways, eyes turning everywhere.
A fallen leaf covers my back.

lines.zh: 我用钳尖剔着壳边的沙。
lines.en: I pick sand from my shell with a claw tip.
The sun warms the shallow water.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装作一颗石子。
lines.en: I freeze and pretend to be a pebble.
Your steps make the sand shake.
I raise my eye stalks and see you.
Is that a claw in your hand?
I sidestep back half a step, then stop.
You are too big; I will not start a fight.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛刚好到你脚踝。
lines.en: My eyes reach only your ankle.
Do not put your hand in my sand hole.

lines.zh: 我看着你，钳子慢慢张开。
lines.en: I watch you and slowly open my claws.
Do you live by the water too?

lines.zh: 你一低头，我就缩回沙里。
lines.en: When you look down, I shrink into the sand.
A small dent is knocked into my shell.
I cannot lift my claw.

lines.zh: 这一下正打在我壳的接缝。
lines.en: That blow hit the seam of my shell.
I retreat sideways in a messy line.
Sand has gotten into the wound.
I am missing one leg.
The pain makes my claws tremble.
I need to shrink back into my burrow.
Who is tapping on my thin shell?
I am on my back, crawling slowly.

lines.zh: 那股腥味是从你口袋来的。
lines.en: That fishy smell comes from your pocket.

lines.zh: 有虾的味道，我钳子发痒。
lines.en: I smell shrimp; my claws itch.

lines.zh: 你晃的那块鱼肉我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the fish you are waving.

lines.zh: 我往前挪一点，又装镇定。
lines.en: I shuffle forward a little, pretending calm.
That is the smell of a bug in the water.

lines.zh: 钳子张到最大，我等它动。
lines.en: My claws are open as wide as they go.

lines.zh: 给我一小口，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me one bite and I will follow.

lines.zh: 这腥味让我忘了往沙里缩。
lines.en: This fishy smell makes me forget to burrow.
I circle around your hand.
I only want to sniff, not bite fingers.

lines.zh: 你一脚踢起沙，糊住我的眼柄。
lines.en: Your kick throws sand over my eye stalks.
The bump slides me sideways half a block.
My shell knocks your boot; it is hard.

lines.zh: 我的钳子卡在你裤脚上。
lines.en: My claw is caught on your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 别往这儿踩，我的薄壳会裂。
lines.en: Do not step here; my thin shell will crack.
I am shoved onto my back.
I roll twice in the sand before steadying.
It is crowded under your feet; move over.

lines.zh: 我举钳子敲了下你的鞋。
lines.en: I tap my claw against your shoe.
After the bump I burrow into the sand.

lines.zh: 我把两只钳子举高给你看。
lines.en: I lift both claws high for you to see.
The sand burrow is dug; come inside.
I polished my shell clean today.
I tap your shell with my claw tip.

lines.zh: 河湾的水正好，够我们俩。
lines.en: The river bend is just right for us two.
Do not go; I have not finished waving.
Let us sidle along side by side.
Your eye stalks are a little taller than mine.
I guard the burrow; you go and feed.

lines.zh: 沙子底下，我留了半个洞。
lines.en: Under the sand I saved half a burrow.
I can carry this little pebble.
I haul the shell shard into my burrow.

lines.zh: 钳子里这块东西是我的。
lines.en: This thing in my claw is mine.

lines.zh: 我夹起一根水草拖着走。
lines.en: I drag a water weed in my claw.
Too heavy; I switch to my other claw.
I accept the meat that fell.
I bury it in the sand to hide it.
With two claws I can hold only one thing.
This shard fits my burrow perfectly.
Do not grab it; I am holding tight.

lines.zh: 有只小虾在石头后面动。
lines.en: A small shrimp moves behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那条更小的鱼。
lines.en: I have picked out the smaller fish.
The water bug stops, and so do I.
It is smaller than my claw.

lines.zh: 沙面一抖，我知道它在哪。
lines.en: The sand twitches; I know where it is.

lines.zh: 这只小虾够我吃一整天。
lines.en: This shrimp will feed me all day.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，横着靠过去。
lines.en: I lower myself and sidle closer.
The target is right by the water weed.

lines.zh: 我钳子对准了它的尾巴。
lines.en: My claw is aimed at its tail.
Do not run; this sand offers no escape.
It flees sideways and I chase sideways.
I chase slowly across the sand.
My claw stays aimed at its back.

lines.zh: 它钻进石缝，我钳子伸不进去。
lines.en: It slips into a crack; my claw cannot reach.
My eye stalks track it.
The sand slows my legs.
Half a block closer and I will snap.
I circle the weed to block its path.
It is more panicked than I am.
I keep chasing until my claws close on it.
My claws snap shut with a click.

lines.zh: 我的钳尖钳住了它的尾。
lines.en: My claw tip has pinned its tail.
That pinch barely broke the skin.
I charge sideways into it.
My claw tip digs into its soft part.
It splashes; I pinch harder.
I pin the prey against the sand.
Even small claws have strength.
Stop struggling; I am still hungry.
After one strike I back off half a step.

lines.zh: 湿沙松了，我顶开沙钻出来。
lines.en: The wet sand loosens; I push my way out.
The jungle river's noise wakes me.

lines.zh: 沙里冒出我和另一只小蟹。
lines.en: Another little crab and I rise from the sand.
River mud still clings to my shell.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩以前没我的洞。
lines.en: This shallow flat had no burrow of mine.
First I dig myself a burrow.
Tropical water, warm just right.
Two little crabs poke out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，认了这块地。
lines.en: I raise my claws and claim this ground.

lines.zh: 水草下面就是我的新家。
lines.en: Under the water weed is my new home.
Hot water turns my shell red.

lines.zh: 从沙坡摔下来，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fell from the sand bank; my shell landed first.
The water is too deep; my gills are flooded.
The blast throws all the sand up.
An arrow is stuck at my shell's edge.

lines.zh: 怪味顺着水钻进我的鳃。
lines.en: A strange taste seeps into my gills with the water.
I would even chew an empty snail shell.

lines.zh: 雷劈在河面，我的壳发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river; my shell tingles.
I fall where there is no sand below.
